title: 红金符箓卷轴
summary: 墨色符文与红金装裱相映，一幅适合静观的传统书写作品。
summary_en: Expressive ink symbols and red-and-gold mounting form a striking work for quiet contemplation.
body:
照片展示一幅竖式符箓作品：红底上铺陈墨色符文与印记，上下以金色装裱衬托。竖向构图突出书写的节奏，适合在了解具体规格后规划居家陈列。

本页展示此件作品的外观，供咨询具体款式。作品名称、尺寸、装裱方式及是否可提供同款，请向协会确认；文化寓意不构成实际效果保证。
body_en:
The photograph shows a vertical talisman work with ink symbols and seals on red, framed by gold-toned mounting. Its upright composition emphasizes the rhythm of the written forms.

This page presents the pictured design for inquiry. Confirm the precise work, dimensions, mounting and availability with the Association before planning a display. Cultural meaning does not promise a practical outcome.
